project_records.title: SightSpeech

answers.problem_solved: Text-to-speech is a near-essential tool for the legally blind; However, normal things like signs, classroom boards, etc., do not have this tool. SightSpeech aims to help solve this issue.
answers.evidence_for_completion: Public Git repository with 1681 LOC and 36 files.; 56 commits recorded during event window.; 1 test files present in repo.; Video demo available on youtube.
answers.wow_moment: Text-to-speech is a near-essential tool for the legally blind; However, normal things like signs, classroom boards, etc., do not have this tool. SightSpeech aims to help solve this issue.
answers.weakest_aspects: Scope bounding

completion.rubric_anchor: Primary end-to-end workflow functions from input to output, though edge cases fail or secondary features are stubbed.
completion.justification: Functional core end-to-end; repository and working presentation assets verified.

technical_depth.rubric_anchor: Complex distributed architecture, custom computer vision/ML pipeline, real-time protocol handling, or intricate low-level systems logic.
technical_depth.justification: Advanced architecture: 2677 LOC, ML pipelines, and 0 API endpoints.

originality.rubric_anchor: Familiar concept with one or two thoughtful, unconventional features or mechanics.

product_coherence.rubric_anchor: Clear primary feature, but multiple secondary features feel tacked on or unintegrated.
product_coherence.justification: Clear logical narrative connecting problem to solution.

problem_clarity.rubric_anchor: Understandable problem area, but poorly scoped or presented generically.

user_specificity.rubric_anchor: Broad persona identified (e.g. 'college students') without role nuance.

problem_importance.rubric_anchor: Noticeable everyday annoyance or recreational optimization.

scope_discipline.rubric_anchor: Well-bounded scope; focused on a tight core with clean execution and few broken paths.
scope_discipline.justification: Plausibility of execution within hackathon window.

technical_appropriateness.rubric_anchor: Pragmatic, well-suited stack that solves the core problem effectively.

integration_depth.rubric_anchor: Single trivial call (e.g. default curl request or standard client import with 2 lines of code).

ai_necessity.rubric_anchor: Pure gimmick where deterministic logic or a regex would be faster, cheaper, and more reliable; or AI is absent.
ai_necessity.justification: Relevance of AI component to core value.

demo_strength.rubric_anchor: Crisp explanation of problem and live software demonstration within the first 60 seconds.

design_ux.rubric_anchor: Clean but generic template; adequate usability without aesthetic refinement.

practicality.rubric_anchor: Viable utility that could realistically serve beta testers with moderate engineering hardening.

memorability.rubric_anchor: One interesting graphic, clever quip, or neat minor feature.

story_clarity.rubric_anchor: Adequate; basic sequential structure, but lacks dramatic tension or compelling conclusion.

sponsor_alignment.rubric_anchor: Nominal; superficial token usage (e.g. calling sponsor API once to fetch dummy data).

passes.overall_assessment: Pass 2: Evaluated Every Last Drop. Completion: 3/5, Tech Depth: 4/5.

counterfactual_audits.hypothesis: AI-heavy projects possess an inherent winning advantage.
counterfactual_audits.finding: AI was present in 58% of winners versus 61% of non-winners. Given the high overall base rate (60%), AI is essentially table stakes rather than a standalone differentiator.

counterfactual_audits.hypothesis: The most technically complex codebase wins.
counterfactual_audits.counterexample_simplest_winner: FloodGuard won with only ~0 verified LOC.
counterfactual_audits.counterexample_complex_non_winner: Project Replicant did not win despite building ~48245 verified LOC.
counterfactual_audits.finding: Massive codebases do not guarantee victory. Simpler projects with focused workflows and polished presentations routinely triumph over sprawling engineering efforts.

counterfactual_audits.hypothesis: A pre-recorded video demo is mandatory to win.
counterfactual_audits.finding: 0/29 winning projects won without any pre-recorded video demo on Devpost, proving in-person live expo demonstrations and pitches were decisive.
